name: Chunk-scale Training
definition: Training each chunk independently to handle large, sparse, unbounded scenes with lower capture density and non-object-centric data, using a skybox and coarse environment optimization to prevent inconsistency.
summary: Chunk-scale Training optimizes large, sparse scenes by dividing them into independent spatial chunks, distinguishing itself from standard 3D Gaussian Splatting through skybox integration, modified densification, and depth regularization.
